text: Powers Speciality Hospital has 56 claims through one doctor against zero beds and a 1.3-year registration; 94.6% of claims come from one feeder broker and 100% of payouts drain to a single account, with every patient appearing exactly once. The pattern is volume without physical footprint plus fully concentrated money flow - the ghost-clinic signature, corroborated by a shared registered address with another operation. A legitimate specialist practice can be young and single-doctored, but it does not usually combine a sole referral source with a sole payout drain and zero returning patients. Next step: confirm the facility exists at its registered address and cross-check the implicated broker's other client clinics.
